'''2008 Match Play Championship Day 1 Pierre Dubreuil LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Pierre Dubreuil]] at [[2008 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|ECC-L-quietminingcolony.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS14]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
